title: dbSNP variant identifier context track pack (hg38)
context: dbSNP (NCBI) is the primary public archive of small genetic variants, identified by rsIDs, and is released as US-government public-domain data. A dbSNP rsID context track provides researchers with a reference layer to map published variant identifiers (e.g. rs17879961) to their genomic positions alongside cancer variant tracks like CIViC and ClinVar. Filtered to common/cancer-relevant variants or cancer gene regions, this track complements the cancer-gene packs without introducing re-identification risk from controlled data.
objective: Apply the licensegate-002 gate to dbSNP (including re-identification check), produce a committed PASS artifact, and deliver a dbSNP cancer-gene-region variant identifier track on hg38.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is dbSNP (NCBI, US-gov public domain); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true.
Re-identification check run and PASS recorded; track is filtered to aggregate-level variant identifiers in cancer gene regions, not individual-level genotypes.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; VCF 1-based coordinate convention handled and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; dbSNP rsID features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-dbsnp-009.json.
Per-feature provenance records rsIDs, dbSNP build version, and public-domain license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100; not-medical-advice notice present.
output: output/packs/dbsnp-cancer-genes-hg38/ — VCF/bigBed track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-dbsnp-009.json.
